note: Rules the assembled agent guide MUST still carry. The guide is the only channel that pushes a rule to the model, and a rule the model was never shown is a rule it violates. Every entry is anchored on a distinctive phrase from the shipped text, per locale, so a rule that is reworded, moved behind a condition, pruned by environment, or squeezed out by the byte budget fails scripts/test-agent-guide-rule-contract.mjs by name. Anchors are deliberately short and distinctive: long ones break on harmless copy edits, generic ones stop measuring anything. A rule's `source` says WHERE it lives, so each is checked against its real carrier: "guide" means the assembled AGENT.md, "autonomy-guidance" means the per-prompt block that only full-autonomy sessions receive.

rules.why: Highest-priority gate. It lives in the guide HEAD precisely because losing it under a tight budget is what produced 'confidently wrong, then apologizes'.
Without it the model answers in the skill text's language or the UI language instead of the user's.

anchors.zh-CN: 回复语言必须跟随用户最新一条消息
anchors.en: Reply in the primary language of the user
anchors.ar: استخدم اللغة الأساسية في آخر رسالة

rules.why: The app talks to user-configured gateways. Losing this makes the model claim to be an Anthropic product.
Catalog entries are Lily capability guides, not engine-native skills. Losing this makes the model run `skill <id>` and fail the turn.

anchors.zh-CN: 禁止对这些平台能力执行原生

rules.why: Stops invented 'global skills' and project memory being described as a skill.

anchors.zh-CN: 没有证据就说无法确认

rules.why: Routes anything outside the conversation and workspace through real verification instead of memory.

anchors.zh-CN: 外部事实分流是语义驱动的

rules.why: The model used to flatly deny real app features like scheduled tasks. This is the never-deny rule.
Completion claims must be checked against the user goal, or stated as unverified.

anchors.ar: التحقق من الإكمال يجب أن يكون حلقة مغلقة

rules.why: The index is the ONLY channel that tells the model which skills exist. If its heading is gone, discovery is gone.
Windows PowerShell rules. Environment-conditional by design (agent-guide-blocks): required on win32, and pruned everywhere else because they cannot apply there.
rules.localesKnownMissingWhy: The Arabic guide body never contained a Windows section, so an Arabic user on Windows does not receive these shell rules. Recorded rather than silently tolerated; fixing it means authoring Arabic prose, not a code change.

rules.why: Reported from the field 2026-09-04: in a 全自主 session the model ended its turn asking the user to choose ("要我接着做前端还是先跑全量 mvn test?") while its own task list still showed 8/10 done. permissionMode drove tool auto-approval only and never reached the prompt, so the model never knew the user had opted into autonomy.

anchors.zh-CN: 不要把选择权交回给用户
anchors.en: do not hand the choice back
